newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Lebed, Chechens start peace talks.
newsitem.headline: Lebed, Chechens start peace talks.

text.p: Russian peacemaker Alexander Lebed and Chechen separatist military leader Aslan Maskhadov started a new round of peace talks on Friday in this settlement just outside the rebel region.

Lebed, who flew into Chechnya earlier in the day, said he hoped to sign a framework agreement on a political settlement of the 20-month conflict in which tens of thousands of people have died. Neither Lebed nor Maskhadov made any statement before the talks.
